issues.item: Threat: Avoid Unfamiliar Places: I avoid going to unfamiliar places because I cannot assess the danger
issues.explanation: The threat profile is dominated by hyperarousal/startle to immediate cues (unexpected movement, unexpected touch), which is coherent with war trauma. However, 'avoid unfamiliar places because I cannot assess the danger' implies a broader, more anticipatory danger-monitoring style that would usually be accompanied by appraisals about the world being dangerous or ongoing threat beliefs. Negative Appraisals are absent here, and Threat has no active edge to other nodes in the formulation, so this item is somewhat disconnected from the rest of the profile.

issues.item: Memory: Guilt on Recall: When I remember the event I feel intense guilt
issues.explanation: The memory profile is mainly fragmented/snapshot-based recall, which fits PTSD. But 'intense guilt on recall' introduces a prominent self-evaluative appraisal theme without any Negative Appraisals items and with the Negative Appraisals node entirely disconnected in the formulation. For this profile, guilt appears clinically under-supported and not well integrated with the rest of the selected items.
